description: This Java class 'BuilderExecutionSettings' encapsulates configuration settings used for building a Gradle project within the Android Studio environment. It manages paths, build modes, command-line options, JVM options, and various build flags, with methods to initialize and validate these settings.

classes.name: BuilderExecutionSettings
classes.description: A class that holds configuration settings for executing a Gradle build, including paths, build modes, options, and flags.

methods.name: BuilderExecutionSettings
methods.description: Constructor that initializes build settings based on system properties and environment.
